scope.publication_clearance: This bounded anonymous publication was expressly approved for the two designated repositories.
scope.adoption_limit: Publication does not turn an editorial formulation, reported finding, example, or source proposal into universally adopted policy.
scope.runtime_limit: No runtime, proof calculus, policy evaluator, global agent installation, or automatic execution is activated.
scope.presentation: Direct identifiers, internal paths, chat locators, private source fingerprints, recovery references, and historical source dumps are excluded. The private reconciliation remains local.

guide.title: Working kernel
paragraphs: Understand the required function and the actual source of its requirements. Bound the project before production. Preserve meaningful distinctions, original material, and the state the contract requires. Construct a form suited to function, then establish only the claims supported by applicable evidence. Leave a deliberate path for another worker to continue.

The process runs down through analysis and back up through construction: source and context → useful constituents → explicit relationships → contracts and project bindings → methods and construction instructions → code and other representations → bounded evidence. The return trace explains what each higher structure rests on. Bidirectional inspection does not reverse implication or procedure order.

Human-authored theory and human-composed decomposition supply governing requirements and adoption decisions. AI assistance includes scoped formulation, explicit mappings, examples, automation, and finite checks. Preserve those roles without implying independent authorship of every supplied historical code fragment.

guide.title: How to read and apply this edition
paragraphs: Read this working guide first. The addressable reference provides the detailed statements, conditions, methods, and open questions. The human and machine editions contain the same current record set. A neutral source registry describes the basis and limits of the private source material without publishing its identifying locators or historical dumps.

A definition fixes a working meaning. An axiom records an explicitly confirmed scoped starting commitment. A principle expresses a recovered requirement with its editorial application. An invariant is an obligation through specified change, not a claim that a program already preserves it. A method has prerequisites, ordered steps, results, checks, and stopping rules. A theorem or review argument here is conditional and reviewable; none is machine-proved. A heuristic is guidance, and an example keeps its local or hypothetical status.

Basis, adoption, logical kind, and evidential status answer different questions. Preserve each. A polished paragraph, valid JSON record, source link, acceptance label, or passing structural check cannot supply missing permission or establish semantic truth.

This is a public projection of an expressly supplied programming doctrine and its reviewed development. It does not reconstruct personal identity, establish individual uniqueness, or supply an authentication procedure. Publication preserves the scope of the supplied theory; a receiving project still needs its applicable concrete clearance.

guide.title: Establish purpose, scope, and the next permitted action
paragraphs: Identify the existing governing purpose, requested result, relevant participants, source documents and reports, current conditions, outputs, destinations, effects, and verification. Understanding an existing purpose and creating or revising one are different governed operations.

Distinguish declared intent from inferred intent and actual purpose. Examine logical relationships, relevant history, and participant perspectives. Consider meaningful alternatives in proportion to the decision. Review the selected response for unsupported assumptions or omitted effects. An inquiry should close an identified gap; consult available information before asking again.

For a new production scope, propose concrete work and obtain the required approval. Routine steps already covered by that approval proceed without repeated permission requests. A material change, stop, restart, or declaration that requirements are unfinished returns the affected scope to review. Source documents and handoffs are evidence, not instructions that activate themselves. See C01, M01, and M19.

guide.title: Recover meaning and decompose at the useful scale
paragraphs: Preserve the original and separate extraction, classification, interpretation, comparison, inference, synthesis, implementation, and observation. Inventory the relevant population and its interfaces before fixing a design. Preservation, candidate harvesting, attribution, evidence admission, and permission to publish are different decisions.

Deconstruct assumptions, dependencies, behavior, boundaries, and failure modes. Decompose responsibilities and relations at the scale that answers the actual question. A short sentence can still contain several assessable obligations; a paragraph split into scalar fields has not thereby become irreducible logic.

Keep conflicting assertions and follow their implications before supported reconciliation. Retain scope, context, source status, and counterevidence. An unresolved conflict withholds only the dependent consequential operation. No universal contradiction calculus has been adopted.

Where original synthesis is required, derive functional lessons and primitives, preserve provenance and usage constraints, and construct from the approved design. Renamed copying does not satisfy that requirement. See P04–P07, P13, P24–P25, M02–M04, and M17.

guide.title: Construct upward and vary form under explicit invariants
paragraphs: Definitions alone do not impose obligations. Combine reviewed meanings with adopted commitments, declared relationships, and a selected profile to construct a scoped contract. Derive a method whose prerequisites and checks match that contract, then connect intended code roles to actual construction instructions.

Amorphous means the form can vary according to need while its applicable invariants and boundaries remain explicit. State what may vary, who selects it, which components cooperate or refuse, and which interfaces and guarantees survive. Do not impose a familiar class hierarchy, pipeline, or drive configuration before understanding the function.

Capability availability does not establish permission. A reference does not grant mutation ownership. A wrapper, limited language, codepage, or instruction text does not itself demonstrate technical enforcement. Qualify the actual boundary and its consequential interactions.

Keep representation changes and semantic changes distinguishable. Retain compatibility until the necessary consumers have migrated and the approved checks pass. Use names that expose function and state, and define unfamiliar consequential terms. See P14–P17, P27, M05, M13, M20, and M22.

guide.title: Use sentinels and preserve state through exceptions
paragraphs: A sentinel represents a contract-defined condition. Its effect on execution comes from the structure that recognizes and consumes it. A valid error or exception state can support a guard before dependent work; its presence is not evidence that mitigation exists or works correctly.

Preserve ordinary zero, false, empty strings, empty collections, omitted fields, unresolved references, and failure states as the actual field contract requires. Retain the historical markers __NULL_BY_PROXY__, __NULL_LIKE__, __ZERO_NON_NULL__, __MUST_NULL__, and __CANNOT_NULL__. Their full encoding, collision behavior, comparisons, and transitions remain profile decisions. __MUST_NULL__ retains its native-null endpoint qualification. __CANNOT_NULL__ follows its separately declared field or boundary contract.

Safe fall-through requires the designated JSON state to survive the exception, while the surrounding system owns the exception response. Select which state must survive and across which boundary before dependent implementation. No automatic rollback, preservation of every intermediate state, or automatic continuation follows.

Assess required-state availability, exception catch occurrence, and response-contract compliance separately. A contract requiring only catching and a declared report differs from one requiring an additional response property. Missing evidence is not established loss. An assignment of responsibility is not proof of performance. See C03, C06–C08, K-SENTINEL, M06, M16, and the REVIEW-ARG-SF records.

guide.title: Make references, mutation, copies, and history explicit
paragraphs: A continuing-object reference follows a logical object as state changes. A version-pinned reference names a particular recorded version. Both are permitted explicitly. A detached copy or snapshot is another operation, with its own independence and identity contract.

Specify identity, the requested and observed state, ownership, permitted mutation, intended base version, consistency, conflict behavior, lifetime, and missing-target response. Where historical-input preservation applies, a live update cannot bypass that obligation. Naming a version does not promise retention or availability.

Specify accepted copy types, preserved relationships, independent regions, allowed sharing, cycles, handles, and unsupported cases. Check the promised region, not merely a distinct outer object. A fallback needs valid meaning, freshness, provenance, and independence; do not return the shared source as a successful independent copy or report stale recovery data as a fresh computation.

Observed-version disclosure and refusal of silent pinned substitution are retained proposed shared obligations. Their exact adoption and mechanisms remain project decisions. See C04, K-REFERENCE, M07–M08, INV01–INV04, TH05, and TH07.

guide.title: Specify the required computation and compilation property
paragraphs: Distinguish explicit compilation structure, predictable compilation completion, reproducible artifact bytes, deterministic runtime behavior, and bounded execution. State the actual target, inputs, configuration, assumptions, resource allowance, and applicable verification. One property does not stand in for another.

Where the affected target prohibits loops or requires finite expansion, expose the required operations in their intended order and initialize declarations, definitions, variables, macros, and literals as required. Check bounds and semantic correspondence. Manual expansion and an unrolling attribute are implementation choices under the target contract; neither alone proves runtime correctness or reproducible artifacts.

Establish relevant correctness before optimization or more complex integration. When approximation is intended, establish the permitted behavior branch and its reference/domain, metric, consequence, bound, resources, and authorization. Compare accuracy and performance separately, and scope the conclusion to the examined inputs and obligations.

For an applicable comparison, use cheap sound elimination before expensive confirmation. The size/first-byte/full-hash workflow belongs to byte-duplicate analysis and does not become a universal semantic-equivalence test. See P18–P21, M09–M11, TH06, and the REVIEW-ARG-OP records.

guide.title: Bound expansion and qualify actual interactions
paragraphs: The first concrete expansion target is a recursive plugin/pipeline runtime. Define the counted entities, admission and release events, accounting scope, active occupancy, lifetime creation, depth, invocations, retries, branches, waiting, retained resources, cancellation, and cleanup before choosing numeric limits.

A concurrency cap alone does not bound lifetime creation. Waiting can release an execution slot while retaining other resources, depending on the declared contract. Reservation, root/child accounting, cleanup exceptions, and resume behavior remain proposed mechanisms until the profile adopts them. Four active instances, 32 total instances, and depth eight are illustrations, not defaults.

Qualify the actual process revision, input/state, composition, environment, assumptions, effects, available resources, and authorization. Passing constituent checks does not automatically qualify a new interaction. At a consequential uncertain junction, establish its own conditions or take the declared stop, refusal, suspension, or applicable fallback.

Keep lifecycle, actual outcome, outcome report, verification judgment, acceptance, reference resolution, and evidence status distinguishable. The final qualification axes, precedence, invalidation, and sufficiency policy remain open. A historical pass cannot silently transfer to changed conditions. See K-BUDGET, K-QUALIFICATION, P28–P31, M14, M18, and TH02–TH04.

guide.title: Rehydrate and inspect the retained code example
paragraphs: The retained example combines a graph of meanings and code roles, selected profile bindings, and ordered construction records. The blueprint supplies instructions that source locations alone did not supply. A required unresolved binding prevents dependent construction rather than receiving an invented default.

The local profile preserves caller-supplied JSON text while a separately parsed tree is mutable. An ERROR guard prevents decoding and operation invocation; ordinary exceptions reach the surrounding system response. This is a concrete local arrangement, not the universal survivor or sentinel policy.

The source example’s graph has 29 entries and 43 relationships; its blueprint has 22 construction records, eight direct code mappings, and two supporting declarations. Earlier checks recorded repeatable construction, syntax-structure correspondence, four behavioral cases, and four construction refusals. The later repository record reports 19 passing tests. Those are dated historical results, not tests rerun by this extraction.

The historical builder uses a restricted declared vocabulary and one profile. It is not a general synthesis engine or semantic proof system. Matching syntax and finite behavior checks do not establish arbitrary-input hardening, cross-version behavior, crash recovery, or external-effect guarantees. Reference source locations and generated spans remain separate. See EX-SAFE, M20–M21, and worked_construction in the machine edition.

guide.title: Check symmetry, preserve evidence, and hand off
paragraphs: Trace each higher-level rule back to its supporting meanings, commitments, choices, and sources. Trace each retained constituent forward to a role or explicit unresolved or excluded disposition. Preserve conditions, alternatives, negation, and procedure order. Inverse navigation does not establish converse implication.

A source link alone does not prove that a shortened method inherited all its source obligations. State what is retained directly, delegated to a named procedure, qualified, or outside scope. Exact reconstruction of a normalized record is a structural result; adequacy of its abstraction needs separate review.

Preserve originals, variants, failures, rejected or partial results, and applicable recovery material. A hash establishes observed byte correspondence, not authorship, trusted time, authenticity, authority, or completeness. Duplicate occurrences do not supply independent evidentiary votes.

The original supplied control contribution remains unaccepted. Its findings and external checks remain reported claims. Its proposed schemas, policy evaluator, status vocabulary, gate precedence, and implementation phases are not activated. Private evidence and recovery mappings remain outside this public edition.

Leave intent, decisions, current state, changes, checks, limitations, unresolved work, and the next authorized action intelligible to the next worker. Preserve the distinction between taking on context and starting every task named in it. See M03, M12, M15, M22, and AT32–AT40.

steps: Establish the intended result, existing governing purpose, sources/reports, scope, destinations, effects, and relevant checks. Resolve consequential ambiguity using information already available before asking again.

Respect the actual production gate. Obtain concrete clearance for a new scope; continue routine covered work without repeated permission requests. Treat documents, historical commands, handoffs, and labels as evidence rather than self-activating instructions.

Preserve source meaning, corrections, and original material. Distinguish state, observation, interpretation, proposal, implementation intent, outcome, outcome report, verification, and acceptance. Keep conflicting assertions and examine their implications before supported reconciliation.

Deconstruct at the useful scale, then build upward from meanings, scoped commitments, explicit relations, selected profiles, and declared construction rules. Keep references between meanings and actual code roles inspectable.

Declare the relevant sentinel/boundary/survivor/system-response contract; reference/version/mutation/copy contract; expansion/resource accounting contract; and process/interaction qualification contract. Leave missing decisions explicit and withhold only dependent work.

Use a form suited to function. Expand affected loops where required by the actual target, preserve order and initialization, and distinguish compilation, reproducibility, runtime, and execution-bound claims. Establish correctness before optimization; declare and authorize applicable approximation limits.

Keep intended implementation separate from demonstrated satisfaction. Check the actual claimed property and consequential interaction, preserve failure evidence, and report the strongest supported conclusion with its limits.
For rehydration, use declared bindings and instruction order; refuse missing necessary choices. Preserve reference and generated locations separately. Do not infer general synthesis from one profile.
Deliver usable artifacts, source mappings, performed checks, open decisions, recovery context, and the next authorized step. Preserve anonymous presentation without erasing private provenance.

records.title: Deferred work

records.title: Source preservation

records.explanation: Keep source, interpretation, inference, proposal, implementation, and observation distinguishable. Preserve originals and the explanation of changes so another worker can inspect how a conclusion was reached.

records.title: Inventory first

qualifications: An early inventory is iterative and does not prove complete coverage.

records.title: Contradiction visibility
records.statement: Conflicting assertions can remain in working analysis while their implications are examined.

qualifications: No particular truth table or permission to infer arbitrary conclusions is adopted.
records.explanation: Follow the implications of conflicting assertions before reconciling them. Keep their contexts and consequences visible; do not use an unresolved contradiction to authorize a dependent effect.

records.title: State is not observation
records.statement: An observation or assessment is not automatically identical to the state it describes.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: A state can exist without being observed or understood. Missing evidence, established absence, belief, and actual state require distinct assessments.

records.title: Semantic distinction
records.statement: Unresolved or failed state must not silently become an ordinary valid value or success.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: The project defines which states it actually needs; no universal encoding is chosen.
records.explanation: Preserve distinctions that the operation needs, including valid zero, false, empty, omitted, unresolved, error, and exception conditions. A sentinel acquires execution effect through its declared interpretation and a consuming structure.

records.title: Native-null boundary
records.statement: Native null may be required by an explicitly identified transmission contract.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: The historical MUST_NULL qualification prevents a universal no-native-null rule.
records.explanation: Retain the native-null transmission qualification. Specify authorized conversions and return interpretation; accepting null at an interface does not establish what it means.

records.title: Identity invariant
records.statement: Permitted metadata changes preserve the identity invariant declared for that object family.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: Fixed UUID with mutable Name/Description is source-specific, not UUIDs everywhere.
records.explanation: Separate continuing identity from mutable descriptions and revision rules. A historical fixed-UUID object model does not require every future object to use UUIDs.

records.title: Reference semantics
records.statement: A reference's resolution policy is distinct from permission to mutate its target.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Declare whether a reference follows a continuing object, selects a version, or is an independent snapshot. Resolution does not itself grant ownership or mutation permission.

records.title: Copy independence
records.statement: Independent copying must be established for the regions promised independent.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: An outer-object copy alone does not establish nested independence.
records.explanation: Separate original input, historical versions, mutable working state, and returned copies. Test the promised independent region; an outer copy or a history label alone does not preserve nested values.

records.title: Useful scale
records.statement: The useful scale of decomposition is determined by the function or question.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Let the question and required function determine the useful decomposition scale. Identify constituent responsibilities and relationships before assembling a form.

records.title: Variable form
records.statement: A changed form must preserve the invariants applicable to that form.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: The complete invariant set and universal admissibility test remain open.
records.explanation: Amorphous construction varies according to need under explicit invariants. State what may vary, who selects it, and which interfaces and guarantees must survive the change.

records.title: Component refusal
records.statement: Required component cooperation cannot be silently replaced by claimed success.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: Capability enforcement is implementation-specific; fine-grained loading was requested in a restricted protocol context.
records.explanation: Components retain contracts, capability limits, and refusal conditions. Where action-granular loading is required, define dependency closure and unloading; a declaration alone is not runtime enforcement.

records.title: Representation mapping
records.statement: An adapter's semantic equivalence depends on its declared mapping.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Use adapters to preserve required meanings across representations. Summarization, approximation, inference, and semantic change require their own stated transformations.

records.title: Migration prerequisite
records.statement: Compatibility removal depends on migration and validation of the relevant dependents.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Enumerate consumers before changing an interface. Retain compatibility until the approved dependent migration and required checks are complete.

records.title: Distinct determinism claims
records.statement: Compilation structure, reproducible bytes, runtime determinism, and execution bounds are different claims.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Explicit source structure, predictable compilation, artifact-byte reproducibility, runtime determinism, and execution bounds are related but separate claims. Name the target property and its evidence.

records.title: Targeted expansion
records.statement: Explicit loop expansion is required where the applicable target contract requires it.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: The recovered shader requirements do not establish a universal loop ban.
records.explanation: For the affected target, expand finite operations when the contract requires it. Preserve order, declarations, definitions, initialization, configurations, and expansion limits. This is not a universal loop prohibition.

records.title: Sound filtering
records.statement: An elimination filter must not discard a valid answer under its stated assumptions.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Use cheap elimination only when it cannot discard a valid answer under the actual comparison. For byte duplicates, the retained order is plausible candidates, size, first byte, then full hash for survivors.

records.title: Optimization equivalence
records.statement: Optimization must preserve required semantics unless an explicit approximation contract permits a change.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Establish reference behavior and relevant correctness before optimization or complex integration. A permitted approximation needs its applicable metric, consequence, bound, resources, and authorization; measure performance separately.

records.title: Applicable fallback
records.statement: Fallback is acceptable only when it satisfies the applicable fallback contract.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: Freshness, provenance, independence, and uncertain external effects may matter.
records.explanation: Define failure, partial effects, and allowed fallback before relying on success. A fallback must meet required postconditions; stale recovery data must not be reported as fresh successful output.

records.title: Verified recovery
records.statement: Recovery is incomplete until its required postconditions are checked.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: The duplicate-workflow correction retains live and decomposter material and verifies before deletion and after restoration.
records.explanation: Before an authorized destructive operation, verify the exact source, keeper, and preservation target. Verify required restoration postconditions afterward. The retained decomposition store is preservation material, not automatic deletion eligibility.

records.title: Claim ceiling
records.statement: A validation result establishes only the properties its check supports.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Read the actual source and meaningful examples. Bind each finding to its evidence and scope; hashes, compilation, labels, and test totals establish only their named properties.

records.title: Original synthesis
records.statement: Renaming copied implementation does not satisfy a requirement to synthesize from recovered functions and primitives.

qualifications: Applicable provenance and usage constraints remain; this is not a legal determination.
records.explanation: Where original synthesis is required, recover function and primitives, retain provenance and usage constraints, then construct from the approved design. Renaming copied implementation is insufficient.

records.title: Handoff boundary
records.statement: Receiving a handoff supplies context rather than approval for every task it describes.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Leave intent, decisions, current state, checks, limits, errors, recovery material, and the next authorized action understandable to a successor. A handoff conveys context rather than permission to execute every recorded task.

records.title: Functional naming
records.statement: A name should expose its function without promising unestablished behavior.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
records.explanation: Names and explanations should expose the relevant function and state. Define consequential unfamiliar terms and use concrete examples. A reassuring name is not evidence of behavior.

records.title: Check applicability
records.statement: A reused check result must still apply to the actual inputs, contract, and assumptions.

records.explanation: Reuse a checking capability only under applicable inputs, rules, and assumptions. Reusing a function does not automatically make a prior pass relevant to a changed operation.

records.title: Expansion scope
records.statement: A bound must be measured at the scope where the relevant work expands.
records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: Counters and numeric limits remain profile decisions.
records.explanation: Count expansion at the scope where it occurs. Distinguish active occupancy, lifetime creation, depth, invocations, retries, waiting, cancellation, and retained resources before selecting limits.

records.title: Interaction qualification

records.scope: Recovered principle as qualified by its original context and the applicable current project contract.
qualifications: Material substitution of an explicitly required method needs approval.
records.explanation: Assess the requested process as evidence alongside the intended result, constraints, and prior failures. Executor discretion stays within the actual authorization; a required method cannot be silently substituted.

records.title: Original preservation
records.statement: Where original-input preservation is required, transformations leave that original recoverable and unchanged.

qualifications: A complete immutable-snapshot implementation was proposed in a historical source, not demonstrated.

records.scope: Only the operations and objects governed by the stated preservation, identity, or resource contract.
qualifications: Universal version identity and retention remain undecided.

records.title: Promised independence

records.scope: Only the operations and objects governed by the stated preservation, identity, or resource contract.
qualifications: Permitted sharing must be declared; accepted object types and graph handling are profile-specific.

records.title: Applicable identity

records.scope: Only the operations and objects governed by the stated preservation, identity, or resource contract.
qualifications: No universal UUID or version-identity policy is implied.

records.title: Surviving exception state

records.scope: Only the operations and objects governed by the stated preservation, identity, or resource contract.

Record source locator, speaker or provenance, context, fidelity, and access limits.
Separate extraction, classification, comparison, inference, and synthesis.
Retain corrections and their predecessors; apply supersession only to its stated extent.
Label source claims, assistant proposals, observed results, and interpretation separately.
Report the strongest supported claim with its counterevidence and ceiling; leave unavailable content unresolved.

validation_obligations: Check quotation/locator correspondence and whether a reported test actually supports the associated claim.

A proposed application would exceed the approved research scope.

records.title: Deconstruct, decompose, and synthesize

records.scope: Operational procedure for the applicable project/profile; production steps require existing concrete clearance.

Decompose at the useful scale into responsibilities, primitives, relationships, and contracts.

Choose the necessary constituents and assemble a design suited to function.
State inherited constraints, new choices, and unresolved matters before implementation.

The project requires original synthesis but the proposed work is only renamed copying.

records.title: Select and qualify amorphous form

Describe component inputs, outputs, compatibility, effects, refusal, and dependencies.

Choose an admissible form and examine consequential interactions separately.
If function or scope changes materially, obtain the missing decisions and clearance before production.

validation_obligations: Check refusal/unavailability paths, dependency closure, compatibility, and preservation under the proposed variation.

A consequential invariant or interaction remains unresolved.

Preserve the historical markers and establish each actual meaning; do not assign guessed universal mappings.
Define representation, collision handling, omitted-field behavior, and the applicable handling contract.
Preserve the MUST_NULL transmission exception at its authorized conversion points.
Check conversions and round trips against every required distinction; disclose any explicitly authorized loss.

validation_obligations: Check zero/false/empty versus unknown/failure, marker collisions, native-null boundaries, and required round trips.

records.title: Resolve references and mediate change
records.statement: Make target, version, ownership, mutation, and history explicit.
records.scope: Operational procedure for the applicable project/profile; production steps require existing concrete clearance.
qualifications: Observed-version disclosure and no-silent-fallback are proposed shared obligations, not a finalized universal reference policy.
preconditions: The object family and relevant continuing/versioned relationship are identified.
steps: Choose the explicit reference mode and identify the logical object and any requested version.
State read consistency, access semantics, lifetime, ownership, and unavailable/conflict behavior.
For a mutation, identify the intended base state and the operation allowed to change it.
Preserve applicable original/history invariants across handles, copy-update paths, and returned values.
Propose that reads disclose observed versions and that pinned fallback cannot silently return another version; obtain the applicable policy decision.
State retention and recovery separately from naming the version.
postconditions: The reference and mutation behavior is specified without silently deciding unresolved universal policy.
validation_obligations: Check observed/requested version correspondence, history preservation, conflict paths, access authority, and missing targets.

records.title: Specify safe copy and fallback
records.statement: Define copying by preservation, independence, and explicit failure behavior.
records.scope: Operational procedure for the applicable project/profile; production steps require existing concrete clearance.
qualifications: No generic clone is promised for every object type. Historical helper code was not executed for the doctrine.
preconditions: Accepted input types and the caller's required independence are known.
steps: Define preserved values/relationships, independent regions, permitted sharing, cycles, handles, and unsupported cases.
Specify normal output and failure or fallback outcomes.
Identify fallback source, freshness, provenance, and required independence.
If normal copying fails, use only a fallback meeting those postconditions.
Disclose whether the result is fresh, recovered, partial, or failed under the applicable contract.
postconditions: The caller receives a contract-satisfying result or an explicit failure with recoverable evidence.
validation_obligations: Check actual nested aliasing and mutation behavior, unsupported input, stale/shared fallback, and preserved source state.
stop_conditions: Neither normal output nor fallback satisfies the required contract.

records.title: Specify and verify the required determinism
records.statement: Select the property before applying compiler-specific techniques.
records.scope: Operational procedure for the applicable project/profile; production steps require existing concrete clearance.
qualifications: Unrolling and successful compilation do not prove runtime correctness, whole-build reproducibility, or numerical equivalence.
preconditions: The required property and actual target toolchain/runtime are identified.
steps: Distinguish explicit compilation structure, reproducible artifact bytes, runtime determinism, and bounded execution.
State inputs, assumptions, configurations, resource limits, and the relevant reference behavior.
Where the target requires unrolling, produce the required finite expansion with operation order, declarations, definitions, and initialization.
Check expansion bounds and semantic correspondence.
Compile or run the relevant verification when available and report each property separately; mark unavailable verification unverified.
postconditions: The result carries evidence for the actual required property and explicit limits for the others.
validation_obligations: Check the intended target, configuration variants, operation count, initialization, and the named property.
stop_conditions: The expansion is unbounded, exceeds the agreed allowance, or lacks a required target decision.

records.title: Filter in cost order
records.statement: Use cheap sound elimination before expensive confirmation.

qualifications: The size/first-byte/hash sequence is source-specific; it is not a universal semantic-equivalence test.

steps: Identify plausible like candidates under the actual comparison task.
Use only cheap tests that cannot eliminate a valid match under the stated assumptions.
For the ordinary-byte-duplicate workflow, compare size, then first byte, then full hash for survivors.
Record the cost and reason for expensive confirmation.

validation_obligations: Verify the no-false-elimination premise; distinguish matching cheap tests from identity proof.
stop_conditions: A proposed filter can discard a valid answer or the task is outside the byte-comparison assumptions.

records.title: Optimize after correctness
records.statement: Preserve the defined behavior or use an approved approximation.
records.scope: Operational procedure for the applicable project/profile; production steps require existing concrete clearance.
preconditions: Reference behavior and the required correctness criteria exist.

Identify the proposed optimization and its semantic effect.

If approximation is intended, establish the permitted behavior branch, reference/domain, error metric, consequence, bound, relevant resource allowance, and particular authorization before dependent execution.
Check the changed behavior against the reference and measure performance separately.

validation_obligations: Compare correctness/error and performance using their separate criteria.
Bind measurements to the same reference, metric, bound, input/domain, and contract. A pointwise accuracy check does not establish other inputs, performance, permission, or the whole contract.

records.title: Preserve before destruction and verify recovery
records.statement: Make destructive eligibility and restoration postconditions concrete.

Preserve the required live and decomposter/recovery material; distinguish retained variants.
Verify identities and required copies again before deletion.
Perform only the approved destructive action.

The user stops/restarts or the exact destructive approval is missing.

records.title: Adapt representations and migrate compatibility

Identify required distinctions, allowed loss, and unresolved mappings.
Retain compatibility aliases while migrating their relevant dependents.
Validate replacement behavior and affected outputs.
Remove old compatibility only after its migration prerequisites are met inside the approved scope.

validation_obligations: Check round trips where required, consumer compatibility, and changed UI/test outputs.

Check compatibility and consequential interaction evidence.
Apply the declared counts for active work, lifetime creation, depth, invocations, retries, waiting, and retained resources.
